description: Set or clear the restock threshold (minimum stock) for a quantity-tracked item at ONE location: "alert us when Room 201 drops below 5". Thresholds are per item PER LOCATION, so locationId is required alongside itemId: every row of check_item_availability's distribution carries the locationId of a level that stocks the item, and search_resources (type: "location") returns the id of a location that does not stock it yet. minStock is a number, or null to clear the threshold. "Low" is measured against AVAILABLE stock, the shelf count MINUS what active orders reserved: 14 on hand with 10 reserved against a threshold of 5 IS low (4 available); check_item_availability reports that verdict per level as isLow. While the location is low a restock task is open for the order handlers; raising, lowering or clearing the threshold re-evaluates it immediately. Person-held stock cannot carry a threshold. Requires the manager role. Idempotent: the same value again changes nothing.

itemId.description: Item id (must be a quantity-tracked item)

locationId.description: Location resource id, from check_item_availability's distribution or search_resources

minStock.description: The threshold, or null to clear it

name: set_min_stock

minStock.description: The threshold now in force (absent = cleared)

quantity.description: Stock on hand at that location

title: Set restock threshold
